name: Hayden
source:
Capture target (a hero in this game whom the protagonist has to win over). (?)
An unfortunate shinigami (death god) who assumes anything to be negative. He sees only the bad side of every situation and/or everything around him.
Hayden has a younger brother named [url=/c10673]Vlad[/url], who is also a god.
He has a black female horse named Odelia (オディーリア) which he takes care of daily.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://sunset77light.rdy.jp/sikkoku/t_top.html]the official website[/url].]
